scenes.headline: How one video encoder learns without a target network
scenes.sub: SIGReg replaces the EMA target, the stop-gradient and the predictor.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Creek! LeVJEPA learns video features with a single encoder and a single loss. Here's how it avoids the usual collapse.

scenes.label: The idea
scenes.text: No EMA target, no stop-gradient, no predictor. One encoder grades its own views, and SIGReg keeps it from collapsing.
scenes.say: V-JEPA 2 avoids collapse with an averaged target network, a stop-gradient and a predictor. LeVJEPA drops all three for one regularizer, SIGReg.

scenes.title: One encoder, many views, one loss

steps.say: From each sixteen-frame clip, cut one global view and four local crops, all over the same stretch of time.
Every view goes through the same encoder, in the same forward pass. The target is just the global view's own output.
A small projector turns each clip token into an embedding, and the loss pulls every local embedding toward the global one.

steps.note: 1,024 random projections, each tested against a Gaussian
steps.say: Alone, that collapses to one constant vector. SIGReg forbids it, pushing the batch toward an isotropic Gaussian, tested along random directions.

steps.label: Bidirectional: every frame sees the whole clip
steps.say: A bidirectional encoder lets every frame see the whole clip, including frames that haven't happened yet.

steps.label: Block-causal: this frame and earlier ones
steps.say: The shipped weights use block-causal attention: patches see their own frame and earlier ones, never later. It cost no accuracy.

steps.label: New frames extend it, no re-encoding
steps.say: So a video's representation can grow as new frames arrive, without re-encoding the past. That's what streaming and world models need.

scenes.label: less total pretraining compute than V-JEPA 2, at matched epochs
scenes.note: 5.6x at ViT-L, where it is also 1.9 points more accurate
scenes.say: The payoff: five point six to twenty point eight times less pretraining compute than V-JEPA 2, trained for the same number of epochs.

scenes.text: Collapse can be ruled out by the loss, not the architecture. Then the encoder is free to be causal.
scenes.say: Collapse can be ruled out by the loss, not the architecture. And then the encoder is free to be causal.

recap: One encoder grades its own global and local views
SIGReg keeps embeddings Gaussian, so nothing collapses
scenes.say: To recap: one encoder, one regularizer instead of three safeguards, and attention that only looks back.
